title: Local vanishing gives the pushed injective-resolution augmentation as a quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], i:X.Opens -> X.Etale a continuous functor whose underlying scheme functor is open restriction [def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Use abelian sheaves with the coefficient universe of X, assume sheafification on both sites and HasExt in an arbitrary common Ext universe, and assume abelian sheafPullback i additive. Let F be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Suppose for q>0 the zero endomorphism of U -> H^q(i(U),F) is locally injective [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-iso-locally-bijective]. Then (1) abelian sheafPullback i preserves finite limits; (2) for every injective resolution I of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], the fixed augmentation single(i_*F) -> i_*I, obtained from the inverse single-complex functor comparison followed by i_*(I.ι), is a quasi-isomorphism. The assertion constructs no replacement complex and makes no choice of a comparison map.

theorem zariski_etale_pushed_resolution
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi_inclusion : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hvan : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q →
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
        (0 : i.op ⋙ Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q ⟶
          i.op ⋙ Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q)) :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology) ∧
    ∀ (I : InjectiveResolution F),
      QuasiIso
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
          (i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0).inv.app F ≫
          ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map I.ι)
